data_description.group: The group of your SMA device, where the Modbus connection is configured

data_description.ssl: Whether to use SSL to connect to your SMA device. This is required for newer SMA devices, but older devices do not support SSL
data_description.verify_ssl: Whether to verify SSL certificates. Disable only if you have a self-signed certificate

error.modbus_no_sunspec: Connected to Modbus, but the SMA device does not answer SunSpec on this unit ID. Check that SunSpec is enabled and the unit ID is correct.

data_description.modbus: Controls such as turning the inverter on or off need Modbus. To enable it, log in to the inverter's web interface with the Installer login, go to Device configuration > Modbus, and enable the Modbus TCP server and SunSpec.

data_description.port: The Modbus TCP port of the inverter, usually 502
